source_reads.finding: The public local compiler path is a lightweight query-aware extractive fallback. It segments context into blocks, extracts non-stopword query terms, ranks blocks with lexical term hits plus structural/position heuristics, selects blocks to a line budget, then trims selected lines by the same style of query/structure scoring. It does not require the hosted precision API.

Repository unit tests assert query-relevant strings/blocks survive, token statistics are populated, invalid budgets reject, and precision mode requires an API key. These tests were source-read only in this E1 receipt; they were not executed here.
The Node proxy contains a local engine loader that evaluates an embedded compression engine in a VM and loads an embedded model.json, then calls compressAdaptive locally.

The server-side implementation explicitly describes the default as a local policy. An optional neural boost is opt-in. The same module also implements CCR/retrieval storage using owner-scoped Firestore objects with TTL, which is not suitable as F2 canonical evidence authority.

The ordinary coding-agent compressor path primarily calls the hosted SuperCompress API, requires an API key for non-structured normal compression, has quota/paywall handling, and fail-open behavior for several transport failures. Therefore importing the proxy/API dependency is not the thin zero-incremental-spend F2 path.

The held-out benchmark samples LongBench/public docs and reports token cuts and latency, but its primary QA preservation metric is answer-string containment in the compressed text. That is useful but insufficient to establish preservation of counterevidence, provenance, dependency chains, future-turn evidence, or evidence needed by another GRID cell. Benchmark claims were not independently reproduced in this E1 receipt.

hypothesis: A local query-aware extractive selector can reduce bounded F2 ContextView token load without creating a second truth store, if canonical evidence remains untouched and selected spans retain exact provenance/backpointers.
counterhypothesis: Current-query lexical optimization can remove low-query-overlap evidence that is required for counterhypotheses, causal verification, later turns, or other GRID cells; per-query rewriting can also reduce provider prefix-cache reuse. Answer-string retention alone cannot falsify this failure mode.

do_not_import: hosted SuperCompress API as an F2 runtime dependency
Firestore CCR as canonical evidence or recovery authority
marketing benchmark claims as F2 acceptance evidence
required_f2_invariants: UnifiedDB/original admitted evidence remains canonical and unmodified
every retained unit maps back to exact source evidence identity/span
counterevidence/provenance/system constraints receive protected retention classes rather than query score alone
fallback to uncompressed or bounded exact evidence is available when preservation confidence is insufficient
evaluation includes cache effects and multi-cell/future-turn preservation, not token cut alone

next_discriminator: Claim E2 architecture mapping, bind the selector concept to exact current F2 retrieval/context surfaces, and specify a provenance-preserving protected-class ContextView contract plus a cache-aware cost function. No E3/E4 credit until a bound local reproduction/ablation exists.
